The issuer demonstrates exceptionally strong financial health, characterized by an outstanding current ratio of 12.41, highly robust profitability (gross margin of 89% and operating margin of 44%), and a substantial capital base with total assets of $493.3B. While the total liabilities are high ($444.1B), the immense liquidity, strong earnings generation ($2.48B in Q1 alone), and solid equity buffer ($49.2B) support an upper-medium to high investment grade rating. Taking into account the substantial leverage on the balance sheet alongside the exceptional liquidity and margin profile, the credit risk is extremely low.

DECISION: AA-
